summary: The American Mining Congress objected to permits being required for mining vehicles under the proposed ORV regulations. Their broader concern was that stringent regulations would hinder prospecting and mining on public lands. As a result of their comments and those of other mining interests, the Department revised its final statement to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles.
summary_quote: the American Mining Congress objects to the stringent regulations currently under consideration since they would have the effect of hindering prospecting and mining of minerals on public lands.
